title: Concerning the Five Saviours, the Resurrectors of Those Who Are Dead, Together with the Five Resurrections
teaching_text:
Once again the enlightener speaks: [...

... i]t therein [...].

The second resurrector is [...].

And the third resurrector is the Father, the First [...], because by his word shall all lives [...] gather in and go to him, and they receive [...] and rest.

The fourth resurrector is the Light Mind, because [...]. ⟨p.46⟩

The fifth resurrector to the good [...] is the Father, the First established one [...]. [He ...] all the powers, and he stands firm [...]. He shall unveil the [...] over them [...], and he draws them to him [...], his will [...], and he [...] them, and he stands them up [...] there, and they remain until [...].

Blessed is every one who [...] day of [...] complete [...] for ever.
gardner_synopsis: Chapter 12 has begun a series of kephalaia connected only by their pentadic structure.
editorial_notes: Separated Gardner’s synopsis from the teaching text. Removed manuscript line numbers (e.g. 24, 25, 30, 5, 1º) where they interrupt the English as line-position markers. Removed Coptic line-break slashes “/” and rejoined broken words (e.g. “res] urrector” → “resurrector”, “becau/ [se” → “because”, “es] tablis [he]d” → “established”). Removed page/running-header artifacts (“52”, divider lines, and “THE KEPHALAIA OF THE TEACHER”). Converted the manuscript page marker “(46)” to ⟨p.46⟩ at its point of occurrence. Removed the footnote marker from the body and collected it under footnotes. Lacunae “[...]” and editorial restorations in square brackets have been preserved as given; several phrases remain fragmentary due to manuscript loss/OCR gaps.
